title: Anti Mace Mod
description: This project adds new commands to stop Players from macing and adds a command to send Players in a timeout
body:
This mod adds new commands:

/antimace <name> true/false <time>
To allow/disallow the mace usability for a player. The status is saved so that it remains in effect even after rejoining. Keep in mind that the player can still attack other mobs, but can no longer attack other players.


/plugin antimace toggle true/false
To enable/disassenble the mod
	
/plugin antimace allow <name> true/false
To grant a player permission to execute the /antimace command—since, by 			default, it is only visible and executable by players with operator rights.
Keep in mind that the player retains this right even after rejoining, until you take it 		away again.


/Timeout <name> true/false
To give a player a timeout: the player cannot move or use any items. This can only 		be activated from players with operator privileges.

The mod works on Singelplayer and Multiplayer.

This mod is designed to prevent players from simply "macing" other players. It also aims to ensure that the fun of the game isn't ruined for others.
